title: Decomposition and Task Design
description: Break work into steps an agent can complete and you can verify one at a time — each step small enough to fail cheaply, checkable on its own, and ordered so a mistake surfaces before it compounds.

title: Tools, Files and Blast Radius
description: Decide what an agent may touch before it starts, not after — scoping read, write, execute and network access to what a task actually needs, and making the worst case something you can recover from.

title: Verifying a Chain, Not a Completion
description: Check that every step of a multi-step run actually did what it claimed — treating the agent's own 'done' as a claim to test, not a result to accept, and catching the step that silently failed before four more steps get built on top of it.
